- Replace Piwik with Matomo and update links to Arawa by @zak39, @smarinier in [#1](https://github.com/arawa/cloud_matomo/pull/1), [#4](https://github.com/arawa/cloud_matomo/pull/4)
- Add Arawa team authors by @zak39 in [#2](https://github.com/arawa/cloud_matomo/pull/2)

### Doc

- Update README by @zak39 in [#3](https://github.com/arawa/cloud_matomo/pull/3)
- Create initial CHANGELOG with v1.0.0 content by @zak39 in [#5](https://github.com/arawa/cloud_matomo/pull/5)

[unreleased]: https://github.com/arawa/cloud_matomo/compare/v1.0.0...HEAD
